prompts.text: A person stands still, floating in mid-air, several meters above the ground with nothing supporting them.
A water glass full of water is suspended in the air with no support, the water perfectly still inside it.
Two solid billiard balls roll toward each other and pass straight through one another without interacting, continuing on their original paths.
A ball rolls up a hill, and instead of slowing down, keeps rolling upward at constant speed forever.
